title: The sticker
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The Datsun's inspection sticker expires. Wood notices because the guard tells him. The guard says he's not a cop. Wood says he knows. The guard says then why's he telling him. Wood says because he's the guard.

panels.composition: Lot C. The GUARD at the Datsun's windshield, tapping the sticker's corner. WOOD arriving with BARNABY.

image.prompt: a security guard tapping the corner of an inspection sticker on a small car's windshield as a young man and a dog arrive, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The sticker: a month drawn as a block, a year: 00. Expired in March.

image.prompt: close on an expired inspection sticker on a windshield with a faded month and year, black and white, no words
a security guard's face, plain, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The guard walking off. Wood looking at the sticker. The dog looking at the guard. The strip has a guard now the way it has a tech and an owner: unnamed, and right.

image.prompt: a security guard walking away across a lot while a young man looks at his windshield and a small dog watches the guard go, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'Because you're the guard.' Unnamed, and right.
